h1.en: Example - Calculate Reynolds Number is the heading; concrete pump 40 low pressure or diesel stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「示例 - 计算 雷诺 数」，主体仍是搜索“40”：邢台有三张页，不是一台泵

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for concrete pump 40 low pressure or diesel. The row to open is /products/electric-40-concrete-pump. It prints 26 m³/h. Electric 40’s pressure cell is 23 MPa. It is not a mode switch written onto Electric 40. The low-pressure 40 page’s pressure cell is 20 MPa. Diesel 40 prints 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm and 2800 kg. Electric 40 prints 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm and 2300 kg. It is a separate Xingtai page with 37 kW and 12–15 m³/h. Diesel 40 is 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa and 120 m / 360 m. A buyer who types only “40” still has to pick a page at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric Low Pressure 40 is 37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa and one fine-stone pair, 80 m / 240 m. Electric 40, Electric Low Pressure 40 and Diesel 40 each print Kawasaki 112 on their own sheets. Electric 40 is 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, with fine-stone 120 m / 360 m and aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m. “Low pressure” on this catalogue is the name of Electric Low Pressure 40 and Electric Low Pressure 60. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg, the same frame numbers as Electric 30, not as Electric 40. Diesel 40’s page description ties 120 m / 360 m to 1 cm aggregate, and that sheet does not add a separate maximum-aggregate cell in the specification list used here. The section title “Reynolds Number for Flow in Pipe or Duct” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是搜索“40”：邢台有三张页，不是一台泵的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump。它印 26 m³/h。它不是写在电动40上的挡位。电动40的压力格是 23 MPa。低压40页的压力格是 20 MPa。它是邢台的另一页，37 kW、12–15 m³/h。这份目录里的“低压”是电动低压40和电动低压60的页名。只输入“40”的买家，仍要在河北品锦机械（邢台）选定一页。电动40、电动低压40和柴油40各自的表上都印了川崎 112。柴油40印 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm、2800 kg。电动40印 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm、2300 kg。柴油40是 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、120 m / 360 m。电动低压40是 37 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa，只有一组细石 80 m / 240 m。柴油40的页面说明把 120 m / 360 m 与 1 cm 骨料写在一起，而此处使用的规格列表没有另加最大骨料格。电动低压40印 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm、1200 kg，这组外形数字和电动30相同，和电动40不同。电动40是 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa，细石 120 m / 360 m，13 骨料 40 m / 120 m。节标题「雷诺 数 用于 流量 在 管道 或 风管」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。
